cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Limited-mode RoboWits move_cube episode driver.

Usage: python /app/output/gen.py inspect [tag]
       python /app/output/gen.py ik
       python /app/output/gen.py pose <file.json> [tag]
       python /app/output/gen.py watch <seconds> [tag]
The pose operation accepts a list of 16-value ee_pose targets. It records each
service response under /app/output/runs; this script never uses privileged state.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json, sys, time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
RUNS = OUT / 'runs'
RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def connect():
    return Robot()

def inspect(tag='obs'):
    r=connect()
    obs=r.get_obs(depth=True, video='none')
    dest=RUNS/tag
    obs.save(str(dest))
    print('STATUS',json.dumps(r.status()))
    print('META',json.dumps(obs.meta))
    print('PROPRIO_NOW',json.dumps(obs.meta['proprio']['now']))
    print('SAVED',dest)

def ik_probe():
    r=connect(); obs=r.get_obs(depth=True,video='none'); now=np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'],float)
    q=now[:14]
    quat=[0.0, 0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0] # local +z down; closing axis local +x toward world +y
    candidates={
      'right_pre_green':[0.445,-0.15,0.91,*quat],
      'right_grasp_green':[0.445,-0.15,0.785,*quat],
      'right_place_green':[0.98,-0.15,0.91,*quat],
      'right_pre_red':[0.425,0.16,0.91,*quat],
      'left_pre_red':[0.425,0.16,0.91,*quat],
      'left_place_red':[0.98,0.16,0.91,*quat],
    }
    for label,pose in candidates.items():
      frame='Gripper_Tip_L' if label.startswith('left') else 'Gripper_Tip_R'
      out=r.ik({frame:pose},seed=q)
      print(label,json.dumps(out))
    print('STATUS',json.dumps(r.status()))

def execute_pose_file(path,tag='move'):
    r=connect()
    rows=json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    out=r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32), video='both', video_fps=10)
    dest=RUNS/tag; out.save(str(dest))
    print('RESULT',json.dumps(out.meta))
    print('FINAL_TCP',json.dumps(out.group('tcp_pose')[-1].tolist() if out.proprio is not None and len(out.proprio) else []))
    print('STATUS',json.dumps(r.status()))
    print('SAVED',dest)

def watch(seconds,tag='watch'):
    r=connect()
    obs=r.get_obs(seconds=float(seconds),video='both',video_fps=10,depth=True)
    dest=RUNS/tag; obs.save(str(dest))
    print('META',json.dumps(obs.meta)); print('STATUS',json.dumps(r.status())); print('SAVED',dest)

if __name__=='__main__':
    op=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'inspect'
    if op=='inspect': inspect(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else f'obs_{int(time.time())}')
    elif op=='ik': ik_probe()
    elif op=='pose': execute_pose_file(sys.argv[2],sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv)>3 else f'pose_{int(time.time())}')
    elif op=='watch': watch(sys.argv[2],sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv)>3 else f'watch_{int(time.time())}')
    else: raise SystemExit('unknown operation: '+op)
PY
